name: Elven Gems
summary: Elven Gems are treasure recovered from a sunken vessel in Arathi Highlands. Captain O'Breen is waiting to inspect them.

sections.title: A Pirate's Treasure
sections.body: Doctor Draxlegauge and the professor have spent weeks among Captain O'Breen's pirates. Now they fear being caught with the treasure, so they send you to bring the Elven Gems to the captain. O'Breen is waiting on the bridge.

faq.answer: They are treasure recovered from a sunken vessel and meant for Captain O'Breen to inspect.
Captain O'Breen wants to see the Elven Gems firsthand.

faq.q: Why am I carrying the gems?
faq.answer: Doctor Draxlegauge and the professor fear being caught holding the pirates' treasure, so they send you to Captain O'Breen.

faq.q: Where do I take the Elven Gems?
faq.answer: Take the Elven Gems to Captain O'Breen on the bridge.
